scope: Actual linked ROMs in stock NTSC Mesen, with explicit diagnostic camera/actor RAM injection and AI held still. 60 focused same-radius turns plus23 synthetic wall/pillar/recess, corpse, item and culled-actor controls per ROM. Not a controller-only route or physical-console test.
limitations: Radial vertical anchoring is a stable billboard compromise; exact perspective floor contact away from screen center is intentionally not claimed.
Synthetic geometry cases move an enemy away from its authored encounter position to exercise masking. Its configured floor remains2; player floor/eye is explicitly0/4 in the recess cases.
Timing is producer CPU cycles excluding NMI, at fixed poses. Oblique views may now draw rows previously cropped, so compare identical centered pixels separately from those cases.
